explication: SoundSwitch is a Windows audio-device switching application. Users configure playback and recording devices, then switch them with hotkeys or tray actions; profiles can also route audio automatically for application and window conditions. The map includes the audio control layer, profile and per-application routing, notifications and tray UI, and the documented CLI and updater capabilities. Relationships are limited to README statements and references in the supplied source index; several implementation details were not sampled.
